items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: So, he suggested Maxine Sullivan. So Bill Borden hadn't really heard

ctx.x: And so Bob mentioned the fact that I was at the Riverboat. And I think somewhere along the line, I might've done a gig with Bob Wilber some place -- a private affair -- and he had heard me.
So, he suggested Maxine Sullivan. So Bill Borden hadn't really heard -- he might've heard me years ago.
He came down to the Riverboat and he heard me sing, and he agreed that we should do it.
